title: Two-index H1 directional lead-lag response

research_height.transfer_path: A completed directional hour in one growth index must economically transmit into the next physical hour of the other index before one additive Optimization information seed can exist.

central_question: Does the sign of a completed US100 H1 body predict the next-hour US30 return, or the sign of a completed US30 H1 body predict the next-hour US100 return, densely and broadly enough after doubled spread cost to retain exactly one ordered lead-lag information seed?

Live-Dev's canonical lifecycle snapshot has not added rows since Unit 97, so its three unchanged rows cannot be retuned; this distinct ordered transmission question uses the already frozen Lab market surface without touching Live.

why_now.decision_if_false: Preserve the qualified anchor and close both ordered directions with no magnitude, normalization, clock, hold, reversion, subgroup or symbol rescue.

distinction_from_closed_work.unit_064_common_beta: Unit 064 attributed contemporaneous common and idiosyncratic return components. Unit 103 uses an ordered completed leader hour and measures only the other symbol's following physical hour.
distinction_from_closed_work.unit_093_cross_relative_convergence: Unit 093 used a fixed 17:00 cross-index residual z-score and convergence direction. Unit 103 has no residual, normalization, magnitude threshold, fixed clock or reversion alternative.
distinction_from_closed_work.unit_102_body_engulfing: Unit 102 used two-bar single-symbol body containment across three indices and a four-hour response. Unit 103 uses only one leader body sign, a different follower symbol, and one next-hour continuation.
distinction_from_closed_work.us500_split_question: US500 is deliberately absent. This is an ordered US30/US100 information-transfer question, not the cancelled EA topology split and not a claim that a Tester avoids reading a referenced cross symbol.

immutable_inputs.manifest_rule: Sort name|bytes|uppercase SHA-256 by name, join with LF and SHA-256 UTF-8 without a trailing LF.

implementation.role: One frozen source-free research aggregation; not a validator, parity checker, test harness, reusable CLI product or trading executable.

period_roles.P1: Ordered-pair discovery only; report 2022H2 and 2023 separately.
period_roles.P5: Latest two completed months; veto only and never pair selection.

fixed_signal_and_response.signal: At completed leader bar t, require close minus open to be nonzero. UP means positive and DOWN means negative.
fixed_signal_and_response.trade_direction: Continuation only: the follower position direction equals the completed leader body sign.
fixed_signal_and_response.entry: Follower t+1 H1 open, one physical hour after signal-bar open; export open is bid and ask is bid plus spread points times point.
fixed_signal_and_response.exit: Follower t+2 H1 open, exactly one physical hour after entry.
fixed_signal_and_response.continuity: Both leader and follower must contain exact t, t+1 and t+2 epochs with 3600-second deltas.
fixed_signal_and_response.nonoverlap: At most one unresolved observation in each ordered variant. Ignore every candidate signal through and including t+2; the next possible signal is after the exit row.
fixed_signal_and_response.period_boundary: Signal t and exit t+2 must belong to the same frozen period; no imputation or carry across a boundary.
fixed_signal_and_response.not_used: No body magnitude, return threshold, normalization, high, low, volume, residual, simultaneous divergence, US500, fixed clock, session, reversion book, portfolio state or Live state enters the signal.

premetric_structural_feasibility.scope: Only completed leader open-close sign, exact continuity, timestamps, period membership and unresolved-observation boundaries were consumed from the family-owned copies. No follower future open, spread, P/L, profit factor, drawdown, pair selection, gate or verdict was read or calculated.

fixed_cost_proxy.h1_open_semantics: Export open is bid; ask equals bid plus spread points times point.
fixed_cost_proxy.entry_mid: Entry bid plus one half entry spread in price units.
fixed_cost_proxy.exit_mid: Exit bid plus one half exit spread in price units.
fixed_cost_proxy.gross_usd: Leader direction sign times follower exit midpoint minus follower entry midpoint, times follower contract size and volume.
fixed_cost_proxy.observed_usd: Gross USD minus one half of the entry-plus-exit full-spread price burden times contract size and volume.
fixed_cost_proxy.double_spread_usd: Gross USD minus the full entry-plus-exit spread price burden times contract size and volume; this is binding.
fixed_cost_proxy.commission_swap_financing: Zero in this fixed one-hour trade-free proxy; any retained seed must later face normal native Tester deal economics.
fixed_cost_proxy.economic_authority: Double-spread USD is binding; gross and observed USD are descriptive.

fixed_metrics.book: Count, gross/observed/double-spread net USD, double-spread wins/losses/zeros, profit factor, maximum closed drawdown USD and percent from $100, net-to-drawdown, minimum and ending balance, win rate, mean and median.
fixed_metrics.ordering: Within each ordered variant sort closes by exit epoch and then signal epoch before closed-balance drawdown.
fixed_metrics.discovery_views: Each P1 ordered variant pooled, 2022H2/2023, and UP/DOWN leader-sign books.
fixed_metrics.later_views: Only the P1-selected ordered variant by P2, P3, P4, P5, pooled P2-P4, full P1-P5 and full UP/DOWN books.
fixed_metrics.zero_profit: Retained in count, neither win nor loss, and excluded from profit-factor numerator and denominator.

requirements: All four family-owned input filenames, byte lengths and SHA-256 hashes match the declaration and canonical manifest.
Both CSV files retain the exact nine-column header, strict increasing unique epoch and finite positive OHLC with nonnegative integer volume and spread fields.
Reconstruct every exact structural anchor, including 48,888 physical rows, 24,440 common epochs and 7,191 signals per ordered variant.
Every variant-period has at least 6.5 signals per normal day, at least 100 UP signals and at least 100 DOWN signals.
P1 pooled doubled-spread net is strictly positive.
P1 pooled doubled-spread profit factor is at least 1.10.
P1 pooled doubled-spread net divided by maximum closed drawdown is at least 1.50.
2022H2 and 2023 doubled-spread nets are separately positive.
UP-leader and DOWN-leader P1 doubled-spread nets are separately positive.
fixed_p1_variant_selection_gate.selection: Select at most one passing ordered variant by greater P1 net-to-drawdown, then profit factor, then net USD, then US100_TO_US30 before US30_TO_US100. P2-P5 economics cannot select or switch the pair.
fixed_p1_variant_selection_gate.failure_action: If neither ordered variant passes all seven checks, calculate no P2-P5 economics and close with no seed.

requirements: Selected-variant doubled-spread net is positive and profit factor at least 1.05 separately in P2, P3 and P4.
Pooled P2-P4 profit factor is at least 1.10 and net-to-drawdown at least 1.50.
Latest P5 net is strictly positive and profit factor is at least 1.00.
Full P1-P5 profit factor is at least 1.10 and net-to-drawdown at least 1.50.
Full UP-leader and DOWN-leader doubled-spread nets are separately positive.
No one positive period supplies more than 65 percent of summed positive P1-P5 period net.

fixed_verdict_rules.pass: PASS_H1_DIRECTIONAL_LEAD_LAG_RETAIN_ONE_OPTIMIZATION_INFORMATION_SEED when integrity/density, one P1 pair and every confirmation/latest/full check pass.
fixed_verdict_rules.discovery_failure: FAIL_H1_DIRECTIONAL_LEAD_LAG_NO_P1_VARIANT_NO_SEED when integrity/density pass but neither ordered pair passes P1.
fixed_verdict_rules.later_failure: FAIL_H1_DIRECTIONAL_LEAD_LAG_CONFIRMATION_OR_LATEST_NO_SEED when P1 selects a pair but any later or full check fails.
fixed_verdict_rules.correction: Any input, environment, design, invocation, implementation, parser or serialization defect is a correction state without economic verdict and without an arbitrary retry cap while this frozen economic contract remains unchanged.

decision_translation.pass: Retain exactly one fixed ordered-pair 0.01-volume one-hour continuation as Optimization information only. It has no native fill, shared-risk, portfolio, MT5 drawdown, Lab engineering or Live authority and can open only after a complete macro-map comparison.
decision_translation.failure: Retain no lead-lag seed and preserve every current anchor component, signal, order, risk, slot, capital, stop and exit rule.
decision_translation.correction: Correct engineering until one valid process exists; never count a correction as research failure.
